content:
We need to find template that reproduces the Still-Gennari reaction retrosynthetically. The forward reaction forms alkene and carboxylic ester, breaks alkyne (triple bond) and also breaks C-P, C-C, C-O bonds. For retrosynthesis, we need a template that when applied to product (the molecule given?) yields precursors: the answer from previous step gave two precursors: ["C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO", "CCC(CC)C(=O)OC(=O)/C=C/C=C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O"].

Thus we need to find the template that when applied to the product yields those precursors. We have the product? The product is likely the combined molecule? Actually the previous step applied a template to the molecule (maybe product) and got those two precursors. So we need to retrieve the template ID and mapped_rxn (mapped reaction SMILES) associated with that template.

We need to search template catalog by criteria. The functional groups formed: alkene, carboxylic ester. Broken: alkyne (C-C triple bonds). Also bonds broken: C-P, C-C, C-O. Bonds formed: C=C, C-O (ester). But the tool only supports functional groups and bonds. Let's try search with functional_groups_formed ["C-C double bonds","carboxylic esters"], broken ["C-C triple bonds"]. Use correct names from list: "C-C double bonds" and "carboxylic esters" are in list. "C-C triple bonds" is also in list. So we can search.
